text.en:
On the day of a solar eclipse the sky grew dark at noon.
"The Moon is covering the Sun," said the teacher.

A solar eclipse happens when the Moon comes between the Sun and the Earth and blocks the Sun. We must never look at the Sun directly without proper eclipse glasses.
A lunar eclipse happens when the Earth comes between the Sun and the Moon and its shadow falls on the Moon.
Seasons occur because the Earth's axis is tilted as it goes around the Sun.

problem.en: When does a solar eclipse happen?

text.en: The Moon is between the Sun and Earth.

prompt.en: A friend says it is safe to look at the Sun during a solar eclipse. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: Never look at the Sun without proper filters.

points.en: Tilt of the axis causes seasons.
